October 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM Eastern


#


Bank of America Named to PEOPLE’s 100 Companies That Care List for Eighth Consecutive Year


##


Ranking Highlights Bank of America’s Community Impact Through Employee Volunteerism and Youth Sports Initiatives


## Key points


- Bank of America was recognized as one of PEOPLE’s 2026 100 Companies That Care, marking its eighth consecutive year on the national list.
- The recognition highlights Bank of America’s commitment to supporting communities through sports, including employee volunteerism at major marathons and expanding youth sports access nationwide.


## Key points


CHARLOTTE, North Carolina


N.C.


– Bank of America announced it has been named to PEOPLE’s 2026 100[Companies That Care](https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/companies-that-care/2026) list. This marks the bank’s eighth consecutive year on the list, underscoring its long-standing commitment to supporting teammates and local communities.


To create the list, PEOPLE partnered with Great Place to Work® to analyze confidential feedback from nearly 970,000 employees at major U S


U.S.


employers, alongside data on workplace benefits, corporate culture and community giving.


*"Caring for our teammates and the communities we serve is central to how we operate every day,"* said **[Sheri Bronstein](https://newsroom.bankofamerica.com/content/newsroom/executive-bios/sheri-bronstein.html) , chief people officer at Bank of America** . *"Being recognized for the eighth consecutive year reflects the dedication of our teammates and the impact our partnerships and programs have in communities."*


The 2026 recognition reflects Bank of America’s work to connect communities through the power of sport, including:


- **Endurance Partnerships and Volunteerism:** Serving as the presenting partner of the Boston Marathon and title partner of the Bank of America Chicago Distance Series, the company mobilizes over 1,250 employee volunteers during race weekends to support local communities. The two marathons have also helped raise funds for more than 390 charities and driven economic growth across Boston and Chicago.
- **Youth Sports Access:** Expanding youth sports access through Bank of America’s Sports with Us platform, which empowers young people to learn life lessons through the power of sport. Golf with Us is a signature part of the platform, which offers youth ages 6 to 18 access to tee times for five dollars


$5


or less through a free one-year membership to nonprofit Youth on Course. More than 187,000 kids have enrolled in Golf with Us and logged more than 228,000 rounds of golf through the offer.


To learn more about Bank of America’s award-winning benefits, employee engagement and community support, visit the[newsroom](https://newsroom.bankofamerica.com/content/newsroom/company-overview/initiatives/great-place-to-work.html) .


## Bank of America


Bank of America is one of the world’s leading financial institutions, serving individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses and large corporations with a full range of banking, investing, asset management and other financial and risk management products and services. The company provides unmatched convenience in the United States, serving more than 69 million clients with approximately 3,500 retail financial centers, approximately 15,000 A T Ms


ATMs


(automated teller machines) and award-winning digital banking with approximately 60 million verified digital users. Bank of America is a global leader in wealth management, corporate and investment banking and trading across a broad range of asset classes, serving corporations, governments, institutions and individuals around the world. As the #1 small business lender in the United States ( F D I C


FDIC


), Bank of America offers industry-leading support to approximately 4 million small business households through a suite of innovative, easy-to-use online products and services. The company serves clients through operations across the United States, its territories and more than 35 countries and/or jurisdictions. Bank of America Corporation stock ( N Y S E


NYSE


: B A C


BAC


) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
